crab_butter.text_en: Fresh, medium-bodied dry white wine with delicate creamy and citrus notes; white brut sparkling wine is an alternative.

scallops_grilled.text_en: Medium-bodied dry white wine with fruit, freshness, and delicate creaminess; white brut is also possible.

raw_fish.text_en: Delicate dry white or white brut sparkling wine, fresh and light, with citrus and mineral notes.

fish_plain.text_en: Dry white wine with clean fruit and freshness, light to medium-bodied; delicate white brut sparkling wine is also acceptable.

dumplings.text_en: Delicate dry red wine with soft tannins, or fresh medium-bodied dry white wine suitable for a sour-cream accompaniment.

fish_soup.text_en: Light to medium-bodied dry white wine, fresh, with a clean fruit and citrus profile.

fried.text_en: Fresh white or rose brut sparkling wine, or a light dry white wine, with a clean fruit profile.

potato_pastry.text_en: Fresh, rounded, medium-bodied dry white wine with gentle fruit or creamy notes; white brut is an alternative.

mushrooms.text_en: Delicate dry red wine with soft tannins and woodland notes, or a rounded, fresh, medium-bodied dry white wine.

meat_pastry.text_en: Medium-bodied dry red wine with soft tannins, dry rose, or delicate brut sparkling wine with fried preparations.

sour_cabbage.text_en: Fresh dry or semi-dry white wine with citrus acidity; dry rose with sufficient freshness is an alternative.

white_butter_cream.text_en: Medium-bodied dry white wine with freshness and delicate creaminess; white brut sparkling wine is a refreshing alternative.

meat_dough.text_en: Medium-bodied dry red wine with soft tannins and freshness; fruity dry rose is also acceptable.

pumpkin.text_en: Rounded dry or semi-dry white wine with fruit and floral notes, medium body, and sufficient freshness.

cheese_pastry.text_en: Medium-bodied dry white wine with a rounded texture and freshness; delicate white or rose brut is an alternative.

soft_cheese.text_en: Fresh medium-bodied dry white wine or delicate brut sparkling wine with gentle fruit or creamy notes.

venison.text_en: Medium to full-bodied dry red wine with berry and spice notes, ripe tannins, and freshness.

minced_meat.text_en: Medium-bodied dry red wine with gentle tannins and juicy berry fruit; a fresh rose style is also possible.

olivier.text_en: Fresh white brut sparkling wine is preferred; still dry white wine with citrus acidity and moderate body is an alternative.

roe.text_en: Fresh white or rose brut sparkling wine with delicate fruit; dry white wine with sufficient freshness is an alternative.

grilled_meat.text_en: Fruity medium-bodied dry red wine or a substantial rose, with freshness, moderate tannins, and spice notes.

mayonnaise.text_en: Fresh white brut sparkling wine or dry white wine with noticeable acidity and moderate body; a semi-dry style is acceptable with salted fish and acidic dressing.

vegetable_acid.text_en: Dry rose or fresh white wine with sufficient acidity, light body, fruit, and delicate structure.

salted_fish.text_en: Fresh dry or semi-dry white wine, or delicate brut sparkling wine, with citrus character and low tannins.

cold_meat.text_en: Fresh dry rose, delicate red with soft tannins, or white brut sparkling wine, with moderate body.

veg_pastry.text_en: Fresh medium-bodied dry white wine or dry rose; delicate white brut is an alternative.

meat_soup_tomato.text_en: Dry rose, juicy red with soft tannins, or fresh white wine, medium-bodied with sufficient acidity.

braised_beef.text_en: Medium-bodied dry red wine with fruit, soft tannins, freshness, and moderate spice.

meat_tomato.text_en: Juicy medium-bodied dry red wine with sufficient freshness, berry fruit, and soft tannins; a substantial rose is acceptable.

curd_dessert.text_en: Sweet white or rose wine with fruit and honey notes, a soft texture, and freshness; sufficiently sweet for jam or syrup.

honey_cake.text_en: Full-bodied sweet white wine with honey, fruit, or spice notes and freshness, sufficiently sweet for the cake.

fruit_dessert.text_en: Sweet white or rose wine with fruit, honey, or floral notes and freshness suited to the sweet fruit dessert.

ribeye.text_en: Full-bodied, structured, fresh dry red wine with moderate to pronounced tannins and berry, spice, and smoky notes.

meat_steak.text_en: Medium to full-bodied dry red wine with berry fruit, freshness, moderate tannins, and spice notes.

lamb.text_en: Full-bodied dry red wine with ripe tannins, dark berries, spice, and herbal notes while retaining freshness.

duck_berry.text_en: Medium-bodied dry red wine with red berries, freshness, soft tannins, and delicate spice; a berry-fruited rose style is also possible.

molluscs.text_en: Fresh dry white or white brut sparkling wine, light to medium-bodied, with citrus character and a clean finish.

seafood_citrus.text_en: Dry white wine with pronounced freshness, citrus character, and sufficient acidity; white brut sparkling wine is acceptable.

seafood_tomato.text_en: Dry white or rose wine with sufficient acidity, fresh fruit, moderate body, and delicate tannins.

vegetables_tomato.text_en: Dry rose or juicy medium-bodied red wine with freshness and moderate astringency; fresh white wine is acceptable for vegetable dishes with cheese.

seafood_rice.text_en: Medium-bodied dry white or rose wine with fresh fruit, sufficient acidity, and gentle tannins.

sweet_glaze.text_en: Fruity semi-dry or semi-sweet wine with freshness and a soft structure; a sweeter style is acceptable with a very sweet glaze.

spicy.text_en: Aromatic semi-dry or semi-sweet white wine with fruit, freshness, moderate alcohol, and low tannins.

spicy_sour.text_en: Fresh semi-dry or semi-sweet white wine with citrus and fruit notes, moderate alcohol, and low tannins.

coffee_cocoa.text_en: Full-bodied sweet red wine with chocolate and berry notes, or a rounded sweet white wine with honey and spice character for the creamy base.

meat_general.text_en: Medium-bodied dry red wine with fruit, freshness, and soft to moderate tannins; a substantial dry rose is acceptable.

poultry.text_en: Fresh medium-bodied dry white wine or white brut sparkling wine; delicate red wine is acceptable for confirmed duck and rich preparations.

game.text_en: Medium to full-bodied dry red wine with soft, ripe tannins and berry or spice notes; rounded white wine is acceptable for confirmed delicate game birds.

fish_general.text_en: Fresh dry white or white brut sparkling wine, delicate and light to medium-bodied; dry rose is acceptable for richer preparations.

cheese_general.text_en: Fresh medium-bodied white wine, white brut, or soft red wine; sweet white wine is intended for confirmed blue cheese.

vegetables.text_en: Fresh white wine, dry rose, or delicate red wine with soft tannins, moderate body, and fruit.

legumes.text_en: Fresh medium-bodied white wine or dry rose, or delicate red wine with soft tannins; a fruit profile without dominant oak.

grains.text_en: Fresh medium-bodied white wine, dry rose, or soft red wine; match body and acidity to the sauce.

salads.text_en: Fresh dry white wine, delicate rose, or white brut sparkling wine, light to medium-bodied.

soup_general.text_en: Fresh white wine, dry rose, or soft red wine of moderate body; semi-dry white wine is acceptable with sour or spicy preparations.

savory_pastry.text_en: Fresh medium-bodied white wine, dry rose, soft red wine, or delicate brut, depending on the filling.

fruit.text_en: Fruity semi-sweet or sweet white or rose wine with freshness and delicate structure; semi-dry wine is acceptable with less-sweet fruit.

dessert_general.text_en: Sweet wine with freshness and sufficient body: fruit-and-honey white wine with fruit and cream, berry-fruited red wine with cocoa and chocolate.

eggs.text_en: Delicate medium-bodied dry white or white brut sparkling wine, fresh and fruity; light dry rose is acceptable.

mixed.text_en: Fresh white or rose wine of moderate body, delicate brut, or soft red wine, with fruit and low astringency.

offal_general.text_en: Dry red wine with soft tannins, fresh white wine, or delicate rose of moderate body; match intensity to the offal type and sauce.

crustaceans.text_en: Delicate medium-bodied dry white or white brut sparkling wine with a fresh fruit profile.

crab.text_en: Fresh, delicate dry white or white brut sparkling wine, light to medium-bodied, with clean fruit.

hard_cheese.text_en: Medium-bodied dry white wine with a rounded texture, or dry red wine with soft, ripe tannins, freshness, and fruit.

blue_cheese.text_en: Sweet wine with sufficient body, fruit, and freshness: white, rose, or red depending on the strength of the cheese.

sweet_glaze_rich_meat.text_en: Ripe, fruit-forward dry red wine of medium to full weight, with soft or velvety tannins, freshness and restrained oak. For rich savoury meat with a sweet barbecue or fruit glaze and no chilli. Fruit and texture must balance both the meat and sauce; dessert wine is not the default.

sweet_glaze_duck.text_en: Fresh, ripe berry-fruited dry red wine with medium weight and soft or velvety tannins. For rich duck with a sweet berry or hoisin sauce, without hot chilli. Avoid excessively light texture and dominant wood; keep both duck fat and sauce in the pairing.

spicy_meat.text_en: Fresh off-dry white wine, or a light dry red with explicitly soft elegant tannins, and verified alcohol no higher than12.5 percent. For hot chilli with savoury red meat and no distinctly sweet glaze. Preserve freshness, moderate alcohol and a delicate tannin structure rather than defaulting to a powerful steak wine.
